definitions.explanation: Communication or contact from someone, especially after a period of silence. Often used in the negative to mean 'no word' or 'no news.'
A matter or situation, especially one that is problematic, scandalous, or requiring judgment. Often used in set phrases to characterize the nature of a situation.

examples.english: There's been no word from him.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧{沙汰|さた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: There had been no contact for a long time, but suddenly I heard from them.

examples.japanese: {合否|ごうひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{沙汰|さた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}っている→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: I'm waiting for word on whether I passed or failed.

examples.japanese: ⟦こんな→こんな：02881_konna⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}する→電話する：05652_denwasuru⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧{正気|しょうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{沙汰|さた}⟦じゃない→じゃない：28483_janai⟧。
examples.english: Calling at this hour is sheer madness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地獄|じごく}→地獄：12053_jigoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{沙汰|さた}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{金|かね}→金：02618_kane⟧⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧。
examples.notes: A well-known proverb meaning that money can influence any outcome.

examples.english: Selling it at that price — I can't believe anyone in their right mind would do that.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly encountered in set phrases rather than as a standalone word. The phrase {正気|しょうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{沙汰|さた}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (not the act of a sane person; sheer madness) is extremely common. The proverb ⟦{地獄|じごく}→地獄：12053_jigoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{沙汰|さた}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{金|かね}→金：02618_kane⟧⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧ (even in hell, money talks) is widely known.

Historically, {沙汰|さた} referred to a legal ruling or judgment, and this sense survives in the phrase ⟦{裁判|さいばん}→裁判：02773_saiban⟧{沙汰|ざた} (court case, lawsuit — note the voicing to ざた).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {沙汰|さた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: no word, no contact
- {正気|しょうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{沙汰|さた}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: sheer madness
- ⟦{地獄|じごく}→地獄：12053_jigoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{沙汰|さた}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{金|かね}→金：02618_kane⟧⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧: money makes the world go round
- ⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧{沙汰|ざた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: no news, no contact
